About Us

Crafting Perfection in Every Appalam

Good Boy Appalam is a trusted name based in K.K. Street, Proddatur, Andhra Pradesh. We pride ourselves in producing the finest quality appalams using traditional methods combined with modern hygiene standards.

Our products are made from carefully selected ingredients — premium urad dal, natural spices, and pure water. We also craft authentic Rasam Podi and Sambar Podi from hand-ground spices. Every product is made with love and dedication from our home in Proddatur.
